shortDescription: Migrate one or more Virtual Machines from Cohesity Migrate Jobs

options.name: cluster
options.description: IP or FQDN for the Cohesity Cluster

options.name: cluster_compute_resource
options.description: If the cluster compute resource is specified, VM will be recovered to resource pool under the specified compute resource.

options.name: cohesity_admin
options.description: Username with which Ansible will connect to the Cohesity Cluster. Domain Specific credentails can be configured in following formats AD.domain.com/username AD.domain.com/username@tenant LOCAL/username@tenant

options.name: cohesity_password
options.description: Password belonging to the selected Username.  This parameter will not be logged.

options.name: datacenter
options.description: If multiple datastore exists, datacenter and cluster resource details are used to uniquely identify the resourcepool.

options.name: datastore_name
options.description: Specifies the datastore where the files should be recovered to. This field is required to recover objects to a different resource pool or to a different parent source. If not specified, objects are recovered to their original datastore locations in the parent source.

options.name: detach_network
options.description: If this is set to true, then the network will be detached from the recovered VMs. All the other networking parameters set will be ignored if set to true

options.name: enable_network
options.description: Specifies whether the attached network should be left in enabled state

options.name: end_time
options.description: Restore tasks will be filtered by a start time specified. If not provided the end time is the current time.

options.name: endpoint
options.description: Specifies the network endpoint of the Protection Source where it is reachable. It could be an URL or hostname or an IP address of the Protection Source or a NAS Share/Export Path.

options.name: environment
options.description: Specifies the environment type (such as VMware) of the Protection Source this Job is protecting. Supported environment types include 'VMware'

options.name: interface_group_name
options.description: Specifies the interface name to connect after restoring the VM.

options.name: job_vm_pair
options.description: Key value pair with job names as key and list of Virtual Machines to migrate

options.name: name
options.description: Descriptor to assign to the Recovery Job.  The Recovery Job name will consist of the name_date_time format.

options.name: network_name
options.description: Specifies a network name to be attached to the migrated object.

options.name: power_state
options.description: Specifies the power state of the recovered objects. By default, the migrated objects are powered off.

options.name: prefix
options.description: Specifies a prefix to prepended to the source object name to derive a new name for the recovered object.

options.name: preserve_mac_address
options.description: Specifies whether to preserve the MAC address of the migrated VM.

options.name: recovery_process_type
options.description: Specifies the recovery type.

options.name: resource_pool_name
options.description: Specifies the resource pool name where the migrated objects are attached.

options.name: start_time
options.description: Restore tasks will be filtered by a start time specified. If not provided the start time is set to the last week. Provide value as "origin" for using cluster creation date.

options.name: state
options.description: Determines the state of the Recovery Job. (C)present a recovery job will be created and started. (C)absent is currently not implemented

options.name: suffix
options.description: Specifies a suffix to appended to the original source object name to derive a new name for the migrated object

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Switch determines if SSL Validation should be enabled.

options.name: vm_folder_name
options.description: Specifies a folder name where the VMs should be restored.
